name: E-girl / E-boy
reacts_against: the clean-girl/VSCO-girl mainstream of its moment, reviving emo and scene's dark-plus-accent palette for a new TikTok-native audience.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Winged eyeliner, heavy blush, drawn-on hearts/tears, colorful dyed hair (often "e-girl streaks"), layered clothing, pleated skirts, chains, anime and gaming references
wiki_facts.key_colours: Often black and pink, but can include a wide range of pastels and bright colors

findings: mostly muted — about 89% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
